بَذُورٌ (S, M, A, K) and ↓ بَذِيرٌ (M, K) (tropical:) A man who divulges secrets; (S, M, A;) as also ↓ بَذِرٌ , of which the fem. is with ة: (L:) or one who cannot keep his secret: (T, K:) pl. of the first بُذُرٌ. (T, S, M.) ―
-b2- Also, both the first and second, (tropical:) A calumniator; a slanderer: (K, TA:) pl. of the former as above. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
